A '''Mandalorian''' living centuries before the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] was the founder of a [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Unidentified Mandalorian clan (dueling blade)|clan]]. He wielded a dueling blade called the [[Sword of the First]] in battle. Eventually he came upon a large beast and buried the sword in her skull, but the creature survived the injury and ate him.<ref>{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Treasure Hunting|Sword of the First}}</ref>
